name: RAG Gramática - Present Simple vs Continuous (Nivel A1)

payload.message: Can you explain the present simple tense?

ground_truth.reference_text: The present simple is used for routines, habits, and permanent situations. In affirmative sentences with he, she, or it, we add -s or -es to the verb. For questions and negatives, we use the auxiliary do or does. Example: She works every day. She does not work on Sunday.

name: RAG Gramática - Past Simple verbos irregulares (Nivel A2)

payload.message: Explain how irregular verbs work in the past simple.

ground_truth.reference_text: Irregular verbs in the past simple do not follow the standard -ed rule. Instead, their form changes completely in the affirmative past. For negative sentences and questions, we use the auxiliary did followed by the base form of the verb. Example: go becomes went, have becomes had.

payload.message: How do I form the first conditional in English?

ground_truth.reference_text: The first conditional is used to talk about real and possible situations in the present or future. The structure is If + present simple, followed by will + base verb in the main clause. Example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
